text:
maria_csm: FYI — VectorHealth renewal in ~30 days. Their token usage dropped ~42% over the last 14d and a couple feature flags never turned on. I want a lightweight de-escalation protocol + a clear downgrade-safe path. Quick brainstorm?

sam_prod: Can we get last 30d token & route breakdown first? If this is embedding-heavy, cost/latency spikes might be the trigger.

jesse_csm: I can lead the customer touch. Proposed micro-plan: 1) urgent enablement call (this week), 2) 1-month usage credit tied to adoption milestones, 3) pre-approved downgrade path that preserves key reporting. Need ops to confirm what we can guarantee on downgrade.

lina_ops: Downgrade parity notes: report endpoints depend on v2-kv cache. If we shrink capacity we can provide read-only snapshots + weekly exports. Short-term workaround: enable an SFTP export and a read-only snapshot API. ETA to enable: ~48h. :white_check_mark:

kai_support: Heads up — there's an intermittent 500 coming from embeddings that could look like instability to customers. Example log snippet: ```2026-03-20T15:12:02Z | req_id=abc123 | customer=vectorhealth | model=embed-xl | error=kvcache-miss; transient OOM; retry=1``` Tracked in ENG-5598.

maria_csm: Good catch. Action items: 1) Jesse schedule the enablement call for Thu/Fri, 2) Sam produce a trimmed fallback model/config we can route to if perf dips, 3) Lina enable SFTP exports + snapshot perms, 4) Kai escalate embeddings bug to 24h triage. I'll draft the customer note.

jesse_csm: Scheduling Doodle now. I'll scope a 45m session focused on: key reports walkthrough, quick wins for adoption, and collecting feedback. Will include a short success checklist: onboarding tasks >=80% complete, 2 key reports generated, and <2 errors/week.

sam_prod: For fallback variant I'm proposing `gen-compact-8q` (8-bit quantized) with targets: p95 latency <220ms and ~60% cost reduction. Plan: canary on 5% traffic, routing rule: if p99 > 1s fallback to compact. I can have a Canary up by EOD tomorrow.

lina_ops: Done: created SFTP role `vectorhealth_onboarding_snapshot` with 30d retention. Export path: ```sftp://s3-redwood/vectorhealth/snapshots/2026-03/``` Permissions applied for jesse_csm and maria_csm.

onboard-bot: Created task 'VectorHealth Thu enablement' assigned to jesse_csm, due 2026-03-25.

maria_csm: Draft to customer (short): "We saw a drop in activity and want to help — can we do a quick enablement to walk reports and unblock your team? We'll also offer a 1-month usage credit if we hit a short set of adoption milestones. Thu or Fri work?"

kai_support: ENG-5598 set to high priority. Pinged #eng-runtime and added the sample logs to the ticket. :loud_sound:

jesse_csm: I'll include a 3-question feedback form at the end of the call and request permission to record the session for internal ops review.

maria_csm: Thanks. Quick recap and owners: jesse -> customer call + feedback, sam -> fallback canary by EOD tomorrow, lina -> SFTP snapshot ready, kai -> bug triage 24h. We'll reconvene after the call to finalize downgrade messaging and the exact credit wording. :rocket:

sam_prod: One more note — for the downgrade policy doc, let's include an explicit list of preserved artifacts (reports, exports, snapshots) and a clear timeline for data access post-downgrade (30d default + opt-in archival). I'll draft and drop in this thread.

maria_csm: Perfect. Keep updates short in-thread. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :eyes:
